The '''Plasburst laser cannon''' was a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. Two of the weapons were installed in standard models of the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] designed by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].
